title: Ho gaya shaheed akbar e jawaa'n
body:
ho gaya shaheed akbar-e-jawa
sar ko peet kar keh rahi hai maa
1. jayein to kidhar ghamzada hussain
ho kaha pe tum mere noor-e-ain
pyaas se nazar hai dhuva dhuvan (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. reg-e-garm par arz-e-karbala
ediya ragadta hain mai laqa
seena-e-pisar se hain khoon rava (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. yousuf-e-hussain tha woh mai laqa
margaya woh hum shakl-e-mustafa
khavi qalb par zulm ki sina (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. paal kar jawaan tha jise kiya
uske byah ka gham hi rahgaya
roke kar rahi hain phuphi baya (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. noojawan hain khoon mein tarbatar
kis tarah uthe laasha-e-pisar
hain hussain par saqt imteha (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. maa ke bain se hashr hai bapa
qaak udati hai arz-e-kabala
qoo rolayega ab yeh aasmaa (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. tere qal-o-qat yaad ayengey
maa ko umr bhar khoo rolayeney
royegi tujhe umr bhar yeh maa (2 times)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. sogwar hai sadiq-e-hazi
maa-o-mehar sab aur falak zamee
haye margaya akbar-e-jawaan
